is_anopheles.evidence: The paper models malaria vectors including Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles arabiensis (page 12).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper is a theoretical population genetics modeling study and does not genotype specific target resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No empirical genotype counts, allele counts, or sample sizes are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No field mosquito populations were collected or assayed in this theoretical study.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a pure mathematical/population genetics modeling paper.

sub_country_location.evidence: No empirical field collection sites exist.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No empirical field collections were performed.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Pure theoretical modeling paper without empirical field samples.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary empirical genotype data is missing or needed.

assessment.summary: This paper presents a mathematical population genetics model evaluating a strategy to combine spatial repellents with indoor residual spraying to select for spatial repellence in Anopheles malaria vectors. It contains no empirical mosquito sampling or genotyping data.
exclusion_reasons: Pure modeling paper (not a primary empirical study)
Does not report target insecticide resistance markers
No extractable empirical genotype data provided
No African field mosquito populations sampled
